summary: Reproduced both null-section failures on the prepared main checkout, applied the same narrow value-based guards as the still-open upstream candidate PR #37928, and added regression coverage for the shipped MiniMax config plus null, missing, populated, and priority-fallback cases.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: AssertionError for MiniMax text_config=None, incorrect priority fallback when higher-priority sections are null, and AttributeError for linear_fp8_config=None. Raw output: reports/j-06ee346cd724/raw/failing_before.log

Passing-after config utility and compressed-tensors suites: 76 passed and 2 subtests passed, covering null, absent, populated, and priority-fallback behavior. Raw output: reports/j-06ee346cd724/raw/unit_after_final.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, and registered-test validation hooks passed. Raw output: reports/j-06ee346cd724/raw/precommit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 was enumerated with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but the reproduced code paths only parse CPU-side configuration and no GPU operation was needed or claimed. Raw output: reports/j-06ee346cd724/raw/gpu_inventory.log

remaining_limitations: The reported RedHatAI/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-FP8 live-server reproduction was not run because its model weights were not provided; the exact CompressedTensorsConfig.from_config failure beneath that serving path was reproduced directly.
No semantic model-accuracy, full-model serving, or distributed workload claim is made.

The issue also named historical ModelConfig, ModelOpt, and MuseGlimmer patterns, but those exact presence-only checks are not present in the prepared base; the two still-live and directly reproducible defects were corrected.
